description: This PHP class 'Dependent' extends 'NormalizableDTO' and represents a data transfer object related to dependents of an employee in the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods to serialize dependents data into an array and defines how fields are accessed via getter mappings.

classes.name: Dependent
classes.description: A data transfer object for employee dependents, capable of serializing dependent data and defining field access mappings.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Dependent DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Converts dependents data to an array based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Returns an array mapping field names to getter methods for dependent attributes.
